newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FERDINAND BACK AND SHEARER MAY JOIN HIM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FERDINAND BACK AND SHEARER MAY JOIN HIM.

text.p: Newcastle striker Les Ferdinand returns to action after five weeks of frustration on Saturday -- and could be joined by his England partner Alan Shearer.

Ferdinand has been given the all-clear to play in the premier league game against Sunderland after shaking off the hamstring injury that has restricted him to just one ill-fated substitute outing since March 1.
Shearer has returned to light training this week following his most recent hernia operation. Manager Kenny Dalglish will delay a decision on him until the last minute.
Newcastle are chasing a league double over their Wearside rivals, having won 2-1 at Roker Park in September.
Ferdinand got the winner that night and is hoping to add to his current tally of 18 at St James' Park.
"My goal against Sunderland was the first of the season for me, and it set me off on a run that saw me scored 10 in 12 games,'' said Ferdinand.
"It would be good to get another against them tomorrow. I'm feeling sharp and in the mood.''
Colombian striker Faustino Asprilla is not expected to return to Newcastle until late on Friday having played for his country in the World Cup against Paraguay.
He was sent off after an 81st minute clash with Paraguayan goalkeeper Jose Luis Chilavert then looked on as a last-gasp goal gave Paraguay victory.
"We haven't heard from Tino yet," said Newcastle assistant manager Terry McDermott. "It's a long and tiring trip for him and we'll have to see how he feels."
